lectures.title: Creating & Modifying Custom Groups: the Command `groupadd`

cues.en: Sometimes we want to create our own groups because we want to define our own permission system on Linux.
So let's have a look at how we can create our own groups.
We can use the group add command for this, and the way to go is group Add.
Then we use the options and then the group name.
And as the options, we have different things, but the most important one is minus G.
That allows us to set a custom group ID.
Usually best practice here is that if we want to create a custom group, it should be at least above
the number 1000 the group ID.
But we could also say, for example, hey, all the groups that we want to use in our company should
be in the range, for example, between 5000 and 10,000 to really differentiate them from other groups.
So we can use a custom range and then select the group ID or manually define a group ID.
If we don't use a group ID here as a parameter, it will just automatically generate one for us.
Those group IDs have to be unique, so if a group with this ID already exists, it will not create the
group.
The group info will then be stored in the e.t.c. group file.
So let's just have a look at how I could create a custom group.
I could just add a group here with group ID and then I use a group ID, for example 2500 for example.
I could call it my application or something like this.
Then we can see here I was not able to create this group because I'm missing the permissions, but I
could use a pseudo in front to give myself temporary additional permissions.
And now we can see after I enter my password, we are able or we have that group.
If I now try to list this group, I could look into the e.t.c. group file and we can see here that we
have created a new group here with the group ID 2500.
So now that we have created a group, how can we change a group?
For this we can use the group Mod Command.
So for example, group mod options and then the group name.
And we could, for example, change the name of the group or change the group ID, and this will then
update Etsy Group and Etsy password.
So let's have a look at that one.
So I could say here group mod.
And I would let's say I want to change the my app group and I want to change the name.
For example, here.
I could change the name to my Dash app and I could also change the group ID with the option to, for
example, 5000.
Then I can see again here I need again permissions, so I need a pseudo in front.
And now I have changed the group name and the group id.
If I now open the file e.t.c. group, then you can see here that I've now changed the name and also
the ID.
So this is how you can change a group later.
But you need to be really, really careful.
I know we have not looked that much into file permissions, but you've seen that we have created a file
and that file had an owner as a username and an owner as a group.
And this group is being stored at the on the hard drive as a group ID.
So if you later change the group ID here, those files will no longer be owned by this group.
So whenever you change the group ID at a later date, be aware that the file's owner will not change
with that because the group ID is stored as an ID there.
So this ID is really, really important.
So you should really consider whether you actually want to change the group ID more on those file permissions
later.
When we have such a group, how can we delete a group?
For this we can use the group Del command and we can just delete that group with this syntax.
Important.
This command does not delete group owned files.
So if that this group or a user of that group has created a file, it will not delete that file.
And this command will then update the corresponding group files again and also remove all the users
from that group.
Let's have a look at how that works.
So for example here Group Del, my minus app and then we can see here I need permissions again I put
a sudo before and now this group has been deleted here.
So this is how you can delete a group.
One last note at the end of this lecture, if this group is the primary group of a user, this will
fail.
So the primary group for all the users is extremely essential and each user is required to have a primary
group.
So if we try to delete a group that's the primary group of a user, this will fail.
We can check this for example here.
If I list the groups of my current user and I will try to delete this group here.
This is the primary group.
So I would say here Sudo group del of this group.
Then we can see that it cannot remove the primary group of a user.
So this one does not work.
We are not allowed to delete groups that are the primary group of a user.
So this is how groups work and how you can create custom groups.
Now we have learned a lot about groups.
In the next two lectures, I want to go back to the topic user management, how we can change users
with the Su and with the Sudo command, and we will talk about that in the next two lectures.
